mapper.sql: dt.id, dt.order_id, dt.rider_user_id, dt.task_status, dt.version, dt.distance_km, dt.rider_fee, dt.accepted_time, dt.arrived_store_time, dt.pickup_time, dt.delivered_time, dt.completed_time, dt.create_time, o.order_state, o.order_total, b.business_name, b.business_address, u.username AS customer_name, da.address AS delivery_address, da.contact_name, da.contact_tel, rp.real_name AS rider_name

FROM delivery_task dt JOIN orders o ON o.id = dt.order_id AND o.is_deleted = 0 JOIN business b ON b.id = o.business_id AND b.is_deleted = 0 JOIN users u ON u.id = o.customer_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 JOIN delivery_address da ON da.id = o.address_id AND da.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN rider_profile rp ON rp.user_id = dt.rider_user_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO delivery_task (order_id, rider_user_id, task_status, version, distance_km, rider_fee, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{riderUserId}, #{taskStatus}, 0, #{distanceKm}, #{riderFee}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE dt.task_status = 'WAITING_RIDER' AND dt.rider_user_id IS NULL ORDER BY dt.create_time

SELECT
WHERE dt.rider_user_id = #{riderUserId}
AND dt.task_status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED')
AND dt.task_status IN ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED')
ORDER BY dt.create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE delivery_task SET rider_user_id = #{riderUserId}, task_status = 'ACCEPTED', accepted_time = NOW(), version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{taskId} AND rider_user_id IS NULL AND task_status = 'WAITING_RIDER'

UPDATE delivery_task SET task_status = 'ARRIVED_STORE', arrived_store_time = NOW(), version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{taskId} AND rider_user_id = #{riderUserId} AND task_status = 'ACCEPTED'

UPDATE delivery_task SET task_status = 'DELIVERING', pickup_time = NOW(), version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{taskId} AND rider_user_id = #{riderUserId} AND task_status = 'ARRIVED_STORE'

UPDATE delivery_task SET task_status = 'DELIVERED', delivered_time = NOW(), version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{taskId} AND rider_user_id = #{riderUserId} AND task_status = 'DELIVERING'
UPDATE delivery_task SET task_status = 'COMPLETED', completed_time = NOW(), version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{taskId} AND task_status = 'DELIVERED'
UPDATE delivery_task SET task_status='COMPLETED', completed_time=NOW(), version=version+1, update_time=NOW() WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND task_status='DELIVERED'

UPDATE delivery_task SET task_status = 'EXCEPTION', version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{taskId} AND rider_user_id = #{riderUserId} AND task_status IN ('ACCEPTED', 'ARRIVED_STORE', 'DELIVERING', 'DELIVERED')
UPDATE delivery_task SET task_status = #{targetStatus}, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{taskId} AND task_status = 'EXCEPTION'

UPDATE delivery_task SET rider_user_id = NULL, task_status = 'WAITING_RIDER', accepted_time = NULL, arrived_store_time = NULL, pickup_time = NULL, delivered_time = NULL, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{taskId} AND task_status = 'EXCEPTION'
UPDATE delivery_task SET task_status = 'CANCELLED', version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{taskId} AND task_status = 'EXCEPTION'
UPDATE delivery_task SET task_status = 'CANCELLED', version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{taskId} AND task_status = 'WAITING_RIDER'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM delivery_task WHERE rider_user_id = #{riderUserId} AND task_status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO delivery_exception (task_id, rider_user_id, exception_type, description, previous_task_status, status, create_time) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{riderUserId}, #{exceptionType}, #{description}, #{previousTaskStatus}, 0, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM delivery_exception WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status = 0 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE delivery_exception SET status = 1, resolution_action = #{action}, resolution_note = #{note}, resolver_user_id = #{resolverUserId}, resolved_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
